A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the risk factors for autonomic nerve dysfunction in the early and advanced phases of glucose tolerance are different and are not related to the presence or absence of diabetes.
the risk for peripheral neuropathy is increased in all patients with diabetes, but the risk is highest in patients with poor glucose control, especially those with type 1 diabetes.
